steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus relevant work experience, or alternative combinations. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your standing before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend interactive sessions on demand that fit your schedule while working in Durham's life sciences, healthcare, IT, or government sectors. Earn all required contact hours and receive your completion certificate directly.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application to PMI, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the associated exam fee and wait for PMI's application audit and approval. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce PMP domains and knowledge areas. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing vendor and sit for the four-hour assessment. Our team remains available to answer questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over the three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Choose from PMI-approved learning activities, conferences, or publications. Renew your certification and continue advancing your career in Durham's thriving professional sectors.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
